quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #7
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: Which statement about railroad crossings is true?

options.text: It is illegal to drive around lowered gates at a railroad crossing.
You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger tells you to.
Not all railroad crossings have flashing red lights and gates.

questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when a flagger, stop sign, or warning devices like gates or flashing lights tell you to. Some crossings do not have these devices. It is illegal to drive around lowered railroad gates.

questions.question: After stopping for a school bus that is letting children off:

options.text: Do not go until the children wave at you.
Watch for children walking on the side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children walking on the side of the road.
questions.explanation: After stopping for a school bus with its stop arm out and lights flashing, watch for children walking on the side of the road. Always drive carefully around children.

questions.question: To pass a slow vehicle on a two-lane road with traffic in both directions, you must:

options.text: Flash your lights at oncoming cars.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: Passing on a two-lane road requires you to use the oncoming traffic lane to complete your pass safely. Only pass if it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.

questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for any cars or pedestrians to pass before going.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.
Only when driving in rural areas.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you block normal traffic flow. You can receive a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: To check your blind spot before changing lanes:

options.text: Look in the left side mirror.
Look in the right side mirror.
Look over your shoulder toward where you want to move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder toward where you want to move.
questions.explanation: To check your blind spot before changing lanes, look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.

questions.question: Drivers should use headlights when:

options.text: You can see 400 feet or less ahead.

questions.explanation: The law requires headlights from sunset to sunrise and when you can see 400 feet or less. When it rains, use low beam headlights and windshield wipers.

questions.question: At an intersection with a flashing red light, you should:

options.text: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Stop only if other cars are approaching the intersection.
Stop only if cars are already in the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop, give the right-of-way to others, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may cross the road.

questions.question: Smoking and getting ready to smoke while driving:

options.text: Does not affect your ability to drive.
Takes your attention away from driving.
Does not take your attention away from driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Takes your attention away from driving.
questions.explanation: Smoking while driving is a dangerous distraction because it takes your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and dangers. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. You must slow down.

questions.question: How can you avoid hitting vehicles in your blind spots?

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulder before changing lanes.
Adjust your rearview mirrors every few minutes.
Honk your horn right before turning or changing lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before turning or changing lanes, turn your head and look over your shoulder in the direction you are moving. Check if your blind spot is clear. Do not rely on mirrors alone.

questions.question: If you are in a serious car crash, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop and move your vehicle off the road if possible. Check if anyone is hurt. If so, call 911. You must report the crash to police if someone is injured, killed, or if there is more than $1,000 in property damage (or more than $200 in damage to government property like signs).

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed on that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. When conditions are bad, you must slow down.

questions.question: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes in your direction, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The lane closest to where you came from.
The lane marked with an arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane. Do not change lanes while you are turning.

questions.question: What color lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions?
questions.explanation: Yellow lines divide traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: When driving near a blind person with a white cane or guide dog, what should you do?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When you see a blind pedestrian with a white cane or guide dog, slow down and give them the right-of-way. Be ready to stop to protect them from harm.

questions.question: When can you go through a stop sign with no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check for cross traffic.
After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe.
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe.
questions.explanation: At any stop sign, stop completely before the intersection. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before entering. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What should you do when changing lanes on a highway?

options.text: Check your rearview and side mirrors.
Check your blind spot by looking over your shoulder.

questions.explanation: When changing lanes, signal early. Check your mirrors and your blind spot by glancing over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: Why is it important to watch for motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are smaller and easier to miss than cars. They can hide in your blind spot. It is hard to judge how far away they are or how fast they are going. Always stay alert around motorcyclists.

questions.question: When a driver is turning and a pedestrian is crossing without a traffic light, who must yield?
questions.explanation: Drivers must yield to pedestrians crossing at any intersection without a traffic light, whether or not there is a marked crosswalk.

questions.question: For drivers 21 and older, it is illegal to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:
questions.explanation: Drivers 21 and older cannot drive with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane on a multilane road is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: When two vehicles enter an intersection at the same time from different roads, which must yield?
questions.explanation: At intersections with signs, signals, or no controls, the vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right when they arrive at the same time.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: The center lane is for left turns only. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or to drive straight through.

questions.question: When dealing with pedestrians, a driver must:

options.text: Make sure the pedestrian sees your vehicle.
Always yield, even if the pedestrian is wrong.
Yield only when the pedestrian has the right-of-way.
Slow down and honk near a crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always yield, even if the pedestrian is wrong.
questions.explanation: You must do everything possible to avoid hitting a pedestrian or another vehicle, no matter the situation. Drivers must stay alert and yield to all pedestrians, even if they are crossing where they should not be.

questions.question: On slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Drive at the speed limit with caution.

questions.explanation: Slow down when it rains, snows, or sleets. These conditions make roads slippery. For safety, you may need to drive slower than the speed limit.

questions.question: How can you avoid making emergency stops while driving in traffic?

options.text: Honk your horn to alert others.
Look ahead and keep a safe distance from other cars.
Drive in the right lane only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead and keep a safe distance from other cars.
questions.explanation: A safe following distance gives you time to react to problems ahead without hard braking. This helps prevent the car behind you from crashing into you.

questions.question: On slick roads, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Driving fast on slick roads is dangerous. It is even more dangerous on turns and curves. Slow down when taking turns on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing from the side.

questions.question: When a green traffic light turns on, you should:

options.text: Speed up as fast as possible.
Wait for another driver to wave you on.

questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. But first, check that no traffic or pedestrians are still crossing. Let them go before you move.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. They control traffic and speed. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: Which must you follow before the other three?
questions.explanation: Orders from a police officer come before all signs, signals, and road markings. Police officers, fire police, work zone flaggers, and school crossing guards can direct traffic.
